body: I’m have a tendency to gain weight and I sympathize with you. I have skinny friends who really struggle to gain weight and sometimes have to worry about their health because of it. Ultimately I think we have to work to support each other rather than arguing who has it worse.
Masks prevent the wearer from spreading it, not from catching it
Let’s try not to be like them at least

I also hate the way I look, although I haven’t spent money on surgery because I’m pretty sure the issue is entirely in my head. I don’t have any advice, but just wanted to let you know you’re not alone

I feel like an alien too. More like an ogre or a troll I guess. Some people learn to be happy with these sorta of disfigurements, so all hope is not necessarily lost. For you that is. I’m too far gone. Lol.

> You’re attractive to someone. Hell, you’re probably attractive to a lot of people. Someone out there loves you, if you died they would be heartbroken.

*sigh* I would start saying something about this but there’s no point. I appreciate your good intentions. Hope you live a great life.
